description: A base exception for a module with specific subclasses, so callers can catch the general type or one case.
An exception the compiler forces callers to catch or declare, best kept for recoverable failures at boundaries.
The original exception passed to a new one so the stack trace keeps the underlying problem, read with getCause.
An exception thrown while closing a resource that is attached to the primary exception instead of replacing it.
A caught exception that is ignored or only printed, which hides the real cause of a failure.
A return or throw inside finally that overrides or replaces the exception from the try block.
